zh: “文学城市研究”丛书以城市状况的文学中介与再现为主题，尤其致力于发展研究文学城市的跨学科方法。呼应俄国形式主义对literaturnost，即文学性的关注，“文学城市研究”将强调研究对象的“城市特质”——那些属于城市及城市状况的独有要素——并关注这种特质为原始材料带来什么，以及它对研究的方法路径意味着什么。这一关注使丛书能够纳入城市史、城市规划和文化地理学等相关领域的视角。丛书对原始材料的时期、体裁、媒介、语言或地区不作限制。它以跨学科方法和全球范围，积极约请并征集能面向国际及跨学科读者的作品。
en: The Literary Urban Studies Series has a thematic focus on literary mediations and representations of urban conditions. Its specific interest is in developing interdisciplinary methodological approaches to the study of literary cities. Echoing the Russian formalist interest in literaturnost or literariness, Literary Urban Studies will emphasize the “citiness” of its study object—the elements that are specific to the city and the urban condition—and an awareness of what this brings to the source material and what it implies in terms of methodological avenues of inquiry. The series’ focus allows for the inclusion of perspectives from related fields such as urban history, urban planning, and cultural geography. The series sets no restrictions on period, genre, medium, language, or region of the source material. Interdisciplinary in approach and global in range, the series actively commissions and solicits works that can speak to an international and cross-disciplinary audience.

zh: 本书是我的博士论文的修订扩充版，论文于2017年在莱顿大学区域研究所完成。我要衷心感谢两位导师，他们的指导与陪伴为我的工作带来了巨大帮助。Petra de Bruijn凭借深厚的文本细读经验，帮助我运用叙事学方法，更深入地研究语料中的小说。她始终将我视为同事与朋友，尊重我写下的每一个字、与她分享的每一个想法。Eric Jan Zürcher以最好的方式指导我建立与历史语境有关的联系，作出解释与分析。他以广阔的视野、智慧和学术经验，以其独特、谦逊而深厚的方式，拓展了我的眼界。
en: This book is a revised and extended version of my PhD dissertation, completed in 2017 at Leiden University Institute for Area Studies. I would like to sincerely thank my supervisors whose guidance and companionship contributed immensely to my work. With her deep-rooted experience in close textual analysis, Petra de Bruijn helped me implement the narratological approach and delve deeper into the novels in my corpus. She always treated me as a colleague and a friend, approached respectfully every single word I wrote and every idea I shared with her. Eric Jan Zürcher guided me in the best possible way to make the connections, interpretations and analyses regarding the historical context. He enriched my vision with his wide horizon, intelligence and scholarly experience in his unique, humbly sophisticated manner.

zh: 从本书出版过程的第一天到最后一天，Eric Prieto给予了巨大帮助和鼓励，对此我致以深切而真诚的感谢。我也衷心感谢Jason Finch的帮助与支持。他们相信我的工作具有价值、切合当下，才使本书得以问世。
en: I would like to express my deep and sincere gratitude to Eric Prieto for his enormous help and encouragement from the very first day of this book’s publication process to the last. I also sincerely thank Jason Finch for his help and support. Their belief in the value and timeliness of my work made this book possible.

zh: 我由衷感谢Şükrü Aslan和Murat Cemal Yalçıntan，在研究期间，他们允许我旁听其在米马尔·锡南美术大学开设的城市研究课程。
en: I wholeheartedly thank Şükrü Aslan and Murat Cemal Yalçıntan who allowed me to audit their courses in the area of urban studies at Mimar Sinan Fine Arts University during my research.

zh: 研究初期，我尝试运用米哈伊尔·M. 巴赫金的理论，Ken Hirschkop和Erol Köroğlu慷慨地分享了意见，我对此感激不尽。我也感谢Daniel Hartley，在我比较雷蒙德·威廉斯、弗雷德里克·詹姆逊和特里·伊格尔顿著作中的若干关键概念时，他回答了我的问题。
en: I am indebted to Ken Hirschkop and Erol Köroğlu who very kindly shared their comments on my experimentation with Mikhail M. Bakhtin’s theories at an early stage of my research. I would also like to thank Daniel Hartley who answered my questions while I was comparing some key notions in the works of Raymond Williams, Fredric Jameson and Terry Eagleton.

zh: 我感谢Ayşegül Baykan，对于与研究相关的各类问题，我总可以毫不犹豫地向她请教。我也感谢Emine Bogenç Demirel和Mel Kenne，在最终引向本项目的早期学习阶段，他们为我的学术成长作出了贡献。
en: I thank Ayşegül Baykan to whom I could always consult, without hesitation, on a diverse range of topics related to my research. I would also like to thank Emine Bogenç Demirel and Mel Kenne for their contribution to my academic development at the earlier stages of my studies that lead to this project.

zh: 研究期间，Murat Güvenç与我分享学术洞见，并赞许我的工作，我对此心怀感激。我感谢博士论文答辩委员会成员，包括他，以及Ivo Smits、Ann Rigney和Liesbeth Minnaard；他们的评议指导我将研究转化为图书提案。
en: I am grateful to Murat Güvenç for his scholarly insights and praise for my work which he shared with me during my research. I would like to thank my dissertation committee members including him, Ivo Smits, Ann Rigney and Liesbeth Minnaard whose reviews guided me as I worked on turning my work into a book proposal.

zh: 卡迪尔·哈斯大学自2004年以来一直是我全职任教的地方，在我的学术工作中给予了宝贵支持。我感谢整个卡迪尔·哈斯大学共同体，尤其以下各位；其中有些人已离开学校，但在我心中仍属于这个共同体：Sondan Durukanoğlu Feyiz、Nüket Tan、Sinan Bayraktaroğlu、Elif Akkor、已故的Selhan Savcıgil-Endres、Mark Wyers、Mustafa Aydın、Serhat Güvenç、Yasemin Aydemir、Didem Kılıçkıran、Teoman Türeli、Serap Özyurt和Mehmet Manyas。
en: Kadir Has University, where I have been employed as a full-time member of the academic staff since 2004, provided invaluable support during my scholarly work. I would like to express my gratitude to all the Khas community, and particularly to the following individuals, some of whom are no longer at this institution, but still part of that community for me: Sondan Durukanoğlu Feyiz, Nüket Tan, Sinan Bayraktaroğlu, Elif Akkor, the late Selhan Savcıgil-Endres, Mark Wyers, Mustafa Aydın, Serhat Güvenç, Yasemin Aydemir, Didem Kılıçkıran, Teoman Türeli, Serap Özyurt and Mehmet Manyas.

zh: 2018年夏天，我以短期博士后研究人员身份在柏林莱布尼茨现代东方研究中心（ZMO）工作，这段经历为本书带来了宝贵助益，我要为此感谢Ulrike Freitag和Sonja Hegasy。我也非常感激Zeynep Dinçer、Uğur Dinçer和Sinan Dinçer的友善与慷慨，他们在此期间为我提供了极好的住处；这一宝贵恩惠，我将永远铭记。
en: My time at Leibniz Zentrum Moderner Orient (ZMO) in Berlin as a short-term post-doctoral researcher in the summer of 2018 was a valuable contribution to my book for which I would like to express my gratitude to Ulrike Freitag and Sonja Hegasy. I am also very grateful for the kindness and generosity of Zeynep Dinçer, Uğur Dinçer and Sinan Dinçer who provided me with amazing accommodation during this period, an invaluable beneficence I will always hold in the highest regard.

zh: 父亲Yaşar Baki Cengiz和母亲Mühübe Cengiz始终尽其所能支持我。Yaşar Baki Cengiz还将一篇文章从德语译为土耳其语，帮助了我的工作。多年来如姐妹般相伴的Gaye Eksen，让我在莱顿拥有一个温暖的家。我向他们致以真诚感谢。
en: My father Yaşar Baki Cengiz and my mother Mühübe Cengiz were always there to support me in any way they could. Yaşar Baki Cengiz also contributed to my work by translating one article from German into Turkish. Gaye Eksen, being a sister for all these years, made sure that I had a warm family home in Leiden. I express my sincere gratitude to them.

zh: 我感谢Özgür Orhangazi，在整个项目中，他给予学术建议，帮助我从国外获取资料，并指导我走过从论文到专著的道路。我也真诚感谢那些与我亲近的人；在漫长的研究岁月里，他们的友谊总能使我振奋。Sena Öksüz始终以同情心、智慧和极佳的幽默感陪伴我。Özgür Kalyoncu Akın不仅给予友谊，还送给我许多书，回答我关于出版业的问题。卡迪尔·哈斯大学卫生服务部门的医生Selçuk Uyanık，既作为医生，也作为朋友，给予关心与照料；她所做的远不止维护我的健康。Allison Jane Airhart、Nedime Gökmen和Esra Kurtuluş不仅以友谊丰富了我的生活，也在项目进行期间帮助我度过一些困难时刻。
en: I would like to thank Özgür Orhangazi who supported me with his scholarly recommendations all through the project, his help with acquiring resources from abroad, and his mentoring on the road that goes from dissertation to book. Sincere thanks go to those very close to me whose friendship always uplifted my mood during the long years I spent on this work. Sena Öksüz was always there with her compassion, wisdom and great sense of humour. Özgür Kalyoncu Akın, in addition to her friendship, treated me to many books and answered my questions on the publishing sector. Selçuk Uyanık, the physician at Khas Health Services, did more than keep me in good health with her care and interest both as a doctor and as a friend. Allison Jane Airhart, Nedime Gökmen and Esra Kurtuluş not only enriched my life with their friendship but also helped me overcome some difficult moments during the times I was working on this project.

zh: 我感谢Sarah Atkinson和Amber Çakar，她们细致地校读本书多个章节，回答了我关于语言细微差别的许多问题。我也感谢Şehnaz Şişmanoğlu Şimşek，她以敏锐反馈拓展了我的视角，并在研究的艰难阶段，以对我工作的赞许给予精神支持。我感激她们。
en: I thank Sarah Atkinson and Amber Çakar who meticulously proofread various chapters of this book and answered my numerous questions on the nuances of language. Thanks also go to Şehnaz Şişmanoğlu Şimşek, who with her astute feedback enlarged my perspective and gave me moral support with her compliments about my work during a challenging stage of it. I am grateful to them.

zh: 我由衷感谢Allie Bochicchio Troyanos，在本书整个出版过程中，她尽一切可能支持我；也感谢Rachel Jacobe，在我撰写书稿时，以极其细致、友善和温暖的态度回答我无休止的问题。我也感谢Lieven Ameel和Markku Salmela对提案持积极态度。最后，真诚感谢匿名同行评审者，正是他们富有洞见的建议，使书稿得以最终定形。
en: I wholeheartedly thank Allie Bochicchio Troyanos for supporting me in every way she could during the entire publication process of the book, and Rachel Jacobe who answered my endless questions with ultimate care, kindness and warmth as I worked on the manuscript. Thanks also go to Lieven Ameel and Markku Salmela for their positive approach to my proposal. Sincere thanks go to my anonymous peer reviewers with whose insightful recommendations the manuscript took its final shape.

zh: 我感谢Saliha Paker从一开始就对项目表现出兴趣，与我分享宝贵意见，并以赞许使我安心。我也感谢Herkül Millas对研究表现出鼓舞人心的兴趣，在电子邮件往来中详细回答我的问题。
en: I would like to thank Saliha Paker for the interest she showed in my project from the very beginning, for sharing her valuable comments with me, and for her praise about my work which was reassuring. I also thank Herkül Millas for the encouraging interest he showed in my research and for replying my questions in detail in our email correspondence.

zh: 在项目的构思阶段，与Jean-François Pérouse、Rıfat Bali、Steven Richmond、İlay Örs、İmre Azem、Semih Gümüş和Levent Soysal见面，与Hande Tekdemir通电话，以及与Lieven Ameel和Nurdan Gürbilek通信，给予我的启发与鼓励，远远超出他们当时所能想到。我真诚感谢他们。
en: Meeting with Jean-François Pérouse, Rıfat Bali, Steven Richmond, İlay Örs, İmre Azem, Semih Gümüş and Levent Soysal; speaking to Hande Tekdemir on the phone; and corresponding with Lieven Ameel and Nurdan Gürbilek during the brainstorming stage of this project was much more inspiring and encouraging than they could have guessed at that moment. I thank them sincerely.

zh: Didem Danış刚生下孩子不久，便花了整整一个下午与我讨论研究，我愿在此再次感谢她。我也感谢Murat Belge，他在比尔吉大学接待我，回答了我关于他一篇文章的问题。Abidin Parıltı和Sabri Gürses也抽空与我见面、讨论研究，我对此心怀感激。我还感谢通过电子邮件回答我问题的Tanıl Bora、Timour Muhidine、İdris Özyol和Ümit Kurt。
en: Didem Danış spent a whole afternoon with me discussing my research, soon after giving birth to her baby, for which I would like to thank her once again here. I am also thankful to Murat Belge, who welcomed me at Bilgi University and answered my questions on an article he wrote. Abidin Parıltı and Sabri Gürses also spared time to meet with me and discuss my research, for which I am thankful. I’d like to thank Tanıl Bora, Timour Muhidine, İdris Özyol and Ümit Kurt who replied my questions through email correspondence.

zh: 我感谢Burcu Borhan Türeli、Banu Yıldıran Genç、Selin Gürdere、Nil Tonyalı和Hasan Tekgüç，他们就研究中的具体问题提供了宝贵反馈。我也感谢Nicola Verderame、Beki Haleva和Nil Senem Çınga Çarıkçı；他们的友谊与各方面支持，在我的研究岁月记忆中占有难忘的位置。我还要感谢Rob Lewis、Engin Kılıç、Emre Erol、Ecem Sarıçayır、Melis Behlil、Müge Özoğlu、Tahsin Demir、Umut Özkırımlı和Amy Spangler的热心支持。
en: I would like thank Burcu Borhan Türeli, Banu Yıldıran Genç, Selin Gürdere, Nil Tonyalı and Hasan Tekgüç who provided me with valuable feedback on certain points of my work. Thanks go to Nicola Verderame, Beki Haleva and Nil Senem Çınga Çarıkçı who, with their friendship and various sorts of support, have an unforgettable place in the memories of the years I spent with this work. I would also like to thank Rob Lewis, Engin Kılıç, Emre Erol, Ecem Sarıçayır, Melis Behlil, Müge Özoğlu, Tahsin Demir, Umut Özkırımlı and Amy Spangler for their kind support.

zh: Alexander de Groot、Hans Theunissen、Clifford Endres和Burcu Kayışçı Akkoyun对我的工作表现出的兴趣十分珍贵，我愿在此再次感谢他们。我也想补充，能结识莱顿大学以下博士生同伴，我深感幸运：Sandra Sardjono、Behrouz Karoubi、Ben Austin、Xiao Ma、Akiko Tsujita和Dlshad A. Marf Zamua。在此感谢他们与我共度的美好时光。
en: The interest that Alexander de Groot, Hans Theunissen, Clifford Endres and Burcu Kayışçı Akkoyun showed in my work was precious, for which I’d like to thank them here once again. I would also like to add that I feel lucky to have met the following fellow PhD students at Leiden University: Sandra Sardjono, Behrouz Karoubi, Ben Austin, Xiao Ma, Akiko Tsujita and Dlshad A. Marf Zamua. I’d like to thank them here for the lovely times we have spent together.

zh: 我感谢Fokke Gerritsen，在我博士论文答辩后不久，邀请我到荷兰驻土耳其研究所（NIT）作讲座。与学术同仁分享、讨论研究的机会，帮助我进一步完善书稿。我也感谢Güher Gürmen对这次活动的热心协助。
en: I would like to thank Fokke Gerritsen for inviting me to give a lecture at the Netherlands Institute in Turkey (NIT) a short while after I defended my dissertation. The opportunity to share and discuss my work with fellow scholars contributed to my elaborations of the manuscript. Thanks also go to Güher Gürmen for her kind assistance in this event.

zh: 最后，我要感谢以下图书馆的工作人员：卡迪尔·哈斯大学信息中心、博斯普鲁斯大学图书馆、莱顿大学图书馆、İSAM图书馆、巴赫切谢希尔大学巴巴罗斯图书馆、SALT研究中心，以及柏林国立图书馆。这些机构不仅为我提供资料，也提供了一个地方——冬暖夏凉——让我感到踏实、安全、安心，无论身体还是情感上都是如此。在学术工作的艰难时刻，这种意义远非这些简单的话语所能表达。
en: Finally, thanks go to the staff of the following libraries: Khas Information Centre; Bosporus University Library; Leiden University Library; İSAM Library; Bahçeşehir University Barbaros Library; SALT Research; and Berlin State Library. These institutions did not only provide me with sources but also with a place (warm in the winter, cool in the summer) where I felt grounded, safe and secure (both physically and emotionally) which, during the challenging times of scholarly work, meant more than I can express with these simple words.

zh: 《土耳其文学中的城市权利小说：从20世纪60年代至今》赞誉
en: Praise For Right to the City Novels in Turkish Literature from the 1960s to the Present

zh: “把迁移与城市融入概念化为现实和想象之间的互动过程，将为文化与文学研究同城市研究的新近方法——如组装理论和／或行动者网络理论——开辟新的对话渠道。另一方面，丰富的阐释性批评分析与比较，将为那些希望运用文本挖掘、模式识别等数字人文新工具研究相同文本的人，提供有益洞见与关键词。对于所有希望在一般城市与文化研究、尤其迁移研究领域提出新研究问题的学生，《土耳其文学中的城市权利小说：从20世纪60年代至今》很可能成为极有价值的参考。”
en: “The conceptualization of migration and urban integration as an interactive process between the real and the imagined would open up new channels of dialogue between cultural and literary studies and recent approaches to urban studies such as Assemblage and/or Actor Network Theory. On the other hand, the rich interpretive critical analysis and comparisons would produce useful insights and keywords for those who wish to study the same texts with the new tools of digital humanities such as text mining pattern recognition.

will, in all likelihood, be an invaluable reference for all those students who wish to formulate new research questions in urban and cultural studies in general and in the field of migration studies in particular.”

zh: ——穆拉特·居文奇，卡迪尔·哈斯大学伊斯坦布尔研究中心主任，伊斯坦布尔。
en: —Murat Güvenç,

zh: “N. 布凯特·坚吉兹以令人耳目一新的清晰笔触，分析现代土耳其小说中极具活力、复杂而令人印象深刻的乡城迁入者再现。对20世纪60年代至21世纪头十年间出版的七部小说的叙事学细读，借助与现代土耳其社会学、政治学、历史和城市研究的关联阐释而愈加丰富。坚吉兹这部巧妙而令人信服的作品表明，小说家并不满足于观察乡村迁入者在伊斯坦布尔充满挑战的历程，并以虚构再现其经验。这些小说家也为数百万市民——其中大多是迁入者的子女或孙辈——提供了探索更民主、更具分享精神的城市生活可能性的机会。N. 布凯特·坚吉兹以本书呈现了一项植根文学研究的扎实跨学科工作，并邀请读者想象一座不同的、宜居的城市。”
en: “N. Buket Cengiz analyses, with refreshing clarity, the extremely dynamic, sophisticated, and impressive representations of rural to urban migrants in modern Turkish novel. The narratological close readings of seven novels, published between the 1960s and 2000s, are enriched with an interpretation based on associations with sociology, political science, history, and urban studies of modern Turkey. Cengiz’s clever and satisfying work shows that novelists are not content with simply observing the challenging adventures of rural migrants in Istanbul and representing their experiences in fiction. These novelists also introduce opportunities to millions of citizens, mostly children or grandchildren of these migrants, to seek the possibilities of a more democratic and sharing urban existence. With her book, N. Buket Cengiz offers a qualified interdisciplinary work stemming from literary studies, and invites her readers to imagine a different and liveable city.”

zh: ——埃罗尔·克勒奥卢，博斯普鲁斯大学土耳其语言文学系副教授，伊斯坦布尔。
en: —Erol Köroğlu,
